## Learning Objectives
- Define survey sampling terminology
- Name and identify different sampling methods
- Identify a simple random sample
- Implement simple random sampling in R
- Explain different types of non-observation errors
:::


For additional practice problems and reading see

- Ch 1, Ch 2.1-2.3, and Ch 15.1 in [Sampling: Design and Analysis 3rd Edition](https://csu-calpoly.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=cdi_globaltitleindex_catalog_336273757&context=PC&vid=01CALS_PSU:01CALS_PSU&lang=en&search_scope=Everything&adaptor=Primo%20Central&tab=Everything&query=any,contains,sampling%20design%20and%20analysis&offset=0) by Sharon L. Lohr.
- Ch 1, Ch 2.1-2.4, 4.1-4.3 in [Elementry Survey Sampling 7th Edition](https://csu-calpoly.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=alma991070566017102901&context=L&vid=01CALS_PSU:01CALS_PSU&lang=en&search_scope=Everything&adaptor=Local%20Search%20Engine&tab=Everything&query=any,contains,elementary%20survey%20sampling&offset=0) by Schaeffer et. al.
- I don't want to make you purchase these books, but they are useful if you want to do more reading and for all of the **practice problems**
